news.analysis: Goff and the Lions made short work of the Patriots, who lost Drake Maye to an ankle injury during the first quarter. Two of Goff's touchdowns went to Amon-Ra St. Brown while the third went to Isaac TeSlaa. Goff has now thrown for 18 touchdowns and four interceptions in nine games this year. He will now head back to the US to take on the Buccaneers in Week 11.
news.contents: Jared Goff completed 20 of his 31 passes for 303 yards, three touchdowns, and two interceptions while adding a three-yard run in a 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich, Germany in Week 10.
news.title: Jared Goff throws three TDs in Week 10 win

news.contents: Detroit Lions wide receiver Isaac TeSlaa drew two red-zone targets from Jared Goff in the first half against the New England Patriots, one more than he had in Detroit's previous three games combined. He turned the first into a diving 12-yard touchdown, his first of the season, and Goff went back to him from the three-yard line just before halftime. TeSlaa finished Week 10 with two catches for 19 yards on five targets, his highest target total since Week 4. Those scoring chances make him worth ...
news.title: Isaac TeSlaa's Red-Zone Looks Lift His Week 11 Outlook

news.analysis: Robinson was one of the few bright spots in the Atlanta offense Sunday, finishing with over 70 offensive yards in nine of 10 games. The running back remains locked in as a reliable RB1 option in all formats entering the team's Week 11 bye.
news.contents: Bijan Robinson carried the ball 16 times for 71 yards and one touchdown while also catching four of his five targets for six yards in the Falcons' 35-13 Week 10 loss to the Chiefs.
